title: INTRODUCTION TO STATISTICS FOR ENGINEERS
description: Probability, common probability distributions, sampling distributions, estimation, hypothesis testing, control charts, regression analysis, experimental design.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: MTH 252Z, 252HZ, 252 or 252H.
A minimum grade of D- is required in MTH 252Z, MTH 252HZ, MTH 252 and MTH 252H.
books_html: No-cost: Course utilizes open educational resources, materials available through the library, or does not require any purchased materials.
meeting_html: TR 8:30am-9:50am in LINC 210 - Learning Innovation Center 210 (GP) (9/23 to 12/4)
